Hi Alice — thanks for the PO and the heads up. Short answer: we can do both email PDF delivery and portal posting. A few details / next steps below.

1) Delivery channels- We will:
   - Email a PDF invoice to the billing contact on record (accounts@brightfoxgames.co.uk) at invoice generation.
   - Post the invoice to our customer billing portal (secure link) so your procurement system can pull it via SFTP or direct integration.

2) VAT handling (EU/UK customers)
   - We can issue the invoice with your UK VAT number included. For B2B transactions where reverse charge applies, our legal requires the buyer VAT to be listed and we include a reverse charge note.
   - If you want us to zero-rate VAT, we need a copy of your UK VAT registration confirmation (we can accept a screenshot of the HMRC VAT registration page or VAT registration certificate).

3) PO & accounting fields- Please confirm the exact PO number you want printed on the invoice (PO-45892 noted). We can also populate a reference field for your internal cost center.

Monica (cc) will prepare the invoice draft and push it to the portal once we have your VAT confirmation. If you prefer not to use the portal, confirm and we'll email PDFs only.

Next steps: Alice — reply with confirmation of (a) portal OK? (b) same billing email? (c) VAT docs?

Best,

Karthik Iyer
